notes.title: New Game Update for "The Lady Witch: Vengeance" V 0.6.3
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

We are thrilled to announce an exciting new update for "The Lady Witch: Vengeance." Get ready to embark on new adventures with our latest quest addition, "Escort Mission 1 - Protect The Caravan." But first, let's take a look at all the quests available in our game:

**Quests List:**
1. Find NPC In Village
2. Find Bobby In City
3. Kill 4 Ratkin's Nest
4. Find Jennifer at the inn
5. Raid Ratkin's (Repeatable)
6. Raid Graveyards (Repeatable)
7. Raid Dragon Nest (Repeatable)
8. Save Fisherman Village
9. Defend City From Dragon
10. An Injured People Near The Village
11. **New Quest:** Escort Mission 1 - Protect The Caravan (Repeatable)
12. Hunt a Big Red Dragon (Repeatable)
13. Stop The Orc
14. Gain Level until 12
15. Raid Dark Knight's Castle
16. Hunt Ice Dragon (Repeatable)

**Escort Mission 1 - Protect The Caravan:**
In this thrilling new quest, you will take on the responsibility of protecting a valuable caravan as it journeys from the Fisherman Village to the Village of safety. Beware of enemy attacks along the way, as they seek to disrupt the caravan's progress. Your mission is clear: ensure the caravan's safe passage to its destination.

**Quest Details:**
- Escort the caravan and defend it against enemy attacks.
- Safely guide the caravan from Fisherman Village to the Village.
- Quest is repeatable for endless challenges.
- In case of failure, the system will automatically restart the quest, providing you with another chance to succeed.

**Images:**
- Witness the action with in-game images of the caravan protection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/51f9ff311eef830b64dee551eb46eb1e39616de5.jpg[/img]

  - Image 1: Caravan Under Attack (In-Game Screenshot)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/37e72f1ffc021cd51f884956b0e858d532722394.jpg[/img]

  - Image 2: Caravan Successfully Arrived (Win Condition - In-Game Screenshot)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/817280dc63e08908ce71757e3f6281adc837e5d5.jpg[/img]

  - Image 3: Quest Successfully Complete (Quest Failed - In-Game Screenshot)



Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to see you in the game. Stay tuned for more exciting updates and content in "The Lady Witch: Vengeance."

Adventure awaits!

notes.title: Join Our Discord Community for Game Support and Celebrate the Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
🎉 Join Our Discord Community for Game Support and Celebrate the Upcoming Release! 🎮

Greetings, adventurers and fans of "The Vengeance Of Lady Witch"!

We're excited to announce the imminent release of our game, and we've prepared a special treat for you. Introducing our official Discord server—a hub of communication, camaraderie, and support that will enhance your gaming journey.

🔗 Discord Server Invite: hhttps://discord.gg/QzFZVxAXRX

What Awaits You:

🚀 Game Release: The day we've all been waiting for is around the corner! Be part of the excitement as we prepare to unleash "The Vengeance Of Lady Witch" upon the world.
🐞 Bug Reporting: With great power comes the occasional bug. Help us fine-tune the game by reporting any issues you encounter. Your input is invaluable!
🗣️ Direct Interaction: Engage in direct conversations with both the development team and fellow players. Share your insights, suggestions, and stories to shape the game's future.
📢 Exclusive Announcements: Get the scoop on updates, patches, events, and surprises. You'll be the first to know about everything happening in the world of our game.
🎉 Community Unity: Forge bonds with like-minded gamers who share your passion. Learn strategies, discuss tactics, and celebrate each other's achievements.
To celebrate this milestone, we invite you to join our Discord community. This is where the magic happens—where we collaborate to create an unforgettable gaming experience.

The game's release is just around the corner, and we can't wait to share it with you. Join us on Discord to be part of the journey and the celebration!

Stay tuned and keep those swords sharp!

Warm regards,
MonoCG Studio
